_doc: The copies' needs (traits.needs, 0 empty .. 1 full): rest is 1 - weariness (a bed restores it); food and water empty over decayHours and are refilled from the supplies when they drop under eatBelow (one unit, restoreOnEat); company fills near the original or another copy (companyNearPx, companyGainPerHour) and empties alone (solitary copies slower, clingy faster); purpose fills with finished work (purposeOnWork per dig, build, furnishing or chore, more for a want done) and empties idle. mood = the mean, plus muralMood per mural in the warren (up to muralMoodMax); it scales the copy's light between moodLight[0] and [1]. Lamps in the warren slow weariness by lampWakeBonus each, up to lampWakeMax. Needs advance from banked offline time like the Ember pool.
